line: Contemplation, what can human minds grasp? Cuz I’m aimin beyond that And then beyond beyond that
vault_lines: Contemplation, what can human minds grasp?
meaning:
This line is a reference to Ram Dass' book on spirituality/philosophy, “Be Here Now.” Almost everyone on the squad has read this book, and it’s been a very important book to us in different ways. There’s one particular passage that says something to the effect of… in order to reach your truest self, you most go beyond the beyond, and then beyond that. That line was thought provoking and resonated, so this is kind of a shout to that and a riff on that philosophy.

Read that book.
